description: Agent Energy: submit the rate plan a customer is billed on and the plan they were quoted: optionally the account with its id, utility and customer; the quoted plan with its name, code, each rate with its id, component (energy, delivery, demand, a fixed charge or other), time-of-use period, tier, rate and unit, its riders, the dates it takes effect and ends, when it was quoted and where the quote came from; and the billed plan with the same fields and the billing period. The signed report gives the plan on both sides with whether it is the same plan, every rate matched by component, period and tier as matched, above_quote, below_quote, unquoted, not_billed, unrated or unit_differs, the riders quoted, billed, unquoted and not billed, and counts them, and names a mismatch: a billed plan other than the one quoted, a rate above the quote, a charge the quote does not list and a rider the quote does not name; then a rate below the quote, a quoted rate or rider missing from the billed plan, effective dates that differ and a billing period outside the quoted dates, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No rates on either side, an unstated rate or unit, no plan identity and no billing period leave the plan unverified. This reads the plan, beside the bill it produces: one bill’s line items recomputed from the tariff and usage are wever_energy-bill-check, a fee schedule against a general quote or invoice is wever_fee-evidence-check and a quote against the governing terms is wever_terms-match-check. Verdict energy_tariff_mismatched, energy_tariff_partial, energy_tariff_unverified or energy_tariff_matched. POST /api/energy-tariff-check. Reads the energy records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Energy reads an energy customer’s own records and recomputes what they claim: the rate plan billed against the plan quoted, a solar or PPA proposal’s production and savings against its stated assumptions, a supply contract against what was agreed, a charging session against the posted price, a carbon credit or certificate claim against its retirement records, a utility bill against its tariff and usage, a commercial demand charge against interval usage and the tariff’s demand rules, and an equipment efficiency or savings claim against its rating and baseline. Beside it, wever_invoice-check reads any invoice against the job it belongs to and wever_fee-evidence-check a fee schedule against a quote or invoice, while an energy check recomputes energy charges from rates, usage and the tariff’s own rules; wever_contract-diff-check compares two versions of one text, while the contract check reads the signed contract against what was agreed; and wever_environmental-evidence-check reads sustainability claims against offered evidence, while the carbon claim check reads the retirement records behind one claim. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-energy-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-energy/.
